# Terminal integration review - PR 456 @ d9bd07927083965375696006dd7eb52a9dffcc33

## Findings

<!-- findings:begin -->
- [ ] F1 (blocker) `blueprint/src/chapter/ch15_qpbt_combining.tex:1913` - The `\leanok` conditional restricted-consistency theorem bounds the *untilded source* law, but `restricted_lines_consistency_bound` bounds the seed-bearing restricted laws. Fix: use `\widetilde D_{\mathrm v,i}` in this auxiliary statement, keep `lem:qld-xz-lines-restricted` explicitly open on the source laws, and state any source push-forward separately with the needed factorization of the measurement families.
- [ ] F2 (blocker) `blueprint/src/chapter/ch15_qpbt_combining.tex:2255` - The `\leanok` directly indexed sub-line definition describes the projected marginals using untilded source laws, whereas `SubLineWitness.source_mixture` uses seed-bearing `restrictedLinePointDist` and retains each projected axis seed. Fix: write the two marginal mixtures with `\widetilde D_{\mathrm v,i}` and its line marginal, and describe the source marginal identities only after applying the forgetful maps; align `lem:direct-subline-witness-exists` with this corrected definition.
<!-- findings:end -->

## Review

Binding: PR 456, detached worktree HEAD `d9bd07927083965375696006dd7eb52a9dffcc33`, trusted published-main policy and both prompt pairs `14752aafffe26541ece477e3955bec44aa7208b6`, merge base `4cfa73320d8f9b7bc3ef2a2dfbc40f242e94d54c`. This is a **bounded terminal integration assessment**, not a fifth full mathematical proof audit. The normalized patches differ (admission hashes `17eb5fee...` before, `e0bb5446...` after); this is not a patch-identity carry. The residual main-relative diff is exactly four files, 154 insertions and 31 deletions: two Lean docstrings and chapters 13 and 15. I read that full diff, both new TeX nodes, the relevant paper passages and the replacement declarations; unchanged proof bodies were inspected only to establish integration facts.

Prior dispositions, preserving the four actual review records: round 1 `5148574797` at `546f0a1b` raised code F1-F3 (prefix-block description, duplicate fixed-direction resampling, duplicate positivity proof). Round 2 `5151788131` at `c793a863` confirmed these resolved and raised prose F1-F4 (direct-law auxiliary counterpart, completion status, mixed counterpart, implementation-history prose). Round 3 `5155066497` at `2d5ae7f1` confirmed the first seven edits and raised prose F1-F3 (seed/source domain, index translation, prerequisite tags). Round 4 `5235361314` at `e8a69238` approved code and prose, recording the tilded source/refinement distinction, zero-based indexing and dependencies as addressed. At the new head, code F1-F3 remain addressed (`SubLinePrefix.lean:7-12`, shared helper `SubLineUniform.lean:137-150`, and existing positivity proof); round-2 status/prose F2/F4 and round-3 indexing/dependency F2/F3 remain addressed. Round-2 F3 remains covered by the new resampling corollary. Round-2 F1 and round-3 F1, however, are **reopened in the two main replacement entries**, as F2 and F1 above respectively; the old approved branch's explicit tilded sub-line statement and restricted-consistency entry did not survive the integration in equivalent form.

Integration evidence: all five conflicted Lean blobs (`Combining/Lines.lean`, `AxisLineResampling.lean`, `DiagonalResampling.lean`, `RestrictedMixture.lean`, `SubLineUniform.lean`) are byte-identical to `4cfa7332` at HEAD. Main's `avgOver_uniform_lineRepMap_resample_parameter` has the branch helper's same arbitrary-value identity up to naming of the direction variable; axis/diagonal callers already invoke it. Main's `uniformDistribution_map_ldSeed` in `Test/LowDegreeGameTheorems.lean:86` has the same seed-marginal statement as the dropped duplicate, and `RestrictedMixture.lean:45` uses it. `Combining/Lines.lean:1-24` retains main's imports and downstream definitions. No main chapter-15 labels were deleted; the only added labels are `thm:line-parameter-resampling` and `cor:line-point-parameter-resampling`, with links to the surviving fixed-direction, axis, diagonal and mixed identities. Main's `thm:conditional-restricted-lines-consistency` and `lem:qld-xz-lines-restricted` replace the dropped restricted-bound certification and preserve the conditional/source distinction; main's `def:direct-subline-law` and `lem:direct-subline-witness-exists` replace the dropped sub-line certification and preserve directly indexed versus source-carrier scope. **Their domains do not, however, match the retained seed/source notation**, so they do not preserve those earlier corrections in substance.

Domain audit: paper `08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:230-237` (`eq:cl-dlnf`) describes prefix projection, correctly cited by the residual `SubLinePrefix` docstring; `:274-287` defines a seed-forgotten axis law but a seed-bearing diagonal law. Chapter 13 `def:line-point-dist` now explicitly defines `\rho_{\mathsf{ALine}}((u_0,s),u)=((u_0,e_{\chi(s)}),u)` and calls the linked Lean laws tilded refinements. Chapter 15 `def:ith-restricted-line` (lines 1806-1819) likewise assigns tildes to restrictions of those Lean laws and untilded symbols to their push-forwards, correctly translating the paper's one-based index to Lean's zero-based `Fin m`; paper `14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1038-1061` has the source restriction and factors `2m`, `4m^2`. `linePointDist_eq_mixture_restricted` and both inflation inequalities at `Combining/Lines.lean:166-216` match the revised *tilded* mixture lemma (nonnegative functions and one universal bound, with no change in coefficients). Forgetting seeds genuinely gives the stated source mixture inequalities for pulled-back functions. The new resampling entries match `SubLineUniform.lean:137-150`, `AxisLineResampling.lean:28-59`, `DiagonalResampling.lean:29-64`, and `MixedResampling.lean:29-37` on arbitrary real-valued functions, their quantifiers, and zero directions. Their source push-forward explanation is mathematically valid, but is not a separately formalized Lean theorem; it is not claimed as such.

Why F1/F2 block: `restricted_lines_consistency_bound` at `Combining/Lines.lean:269-295` quantifies supplied measurements and takes `restrictedLinePointDist` products whose `LineDesc.axis` contains a scalar seed; source `D_{\mathrm v,i}` discards that seed. The auxiliary node currently uses `D_{\mathrm v,i}` at 1913-1915 under statement-level `\leanok`. Likewise `SubLineWitness.source_mixture` at `Combining/Witnesses.lean:231-238` uses separate X/Z marginals built from seed-bearing `restrictedLinePointDist` (`:179-199`), but the main replacement `def:direct-subline-law` uses `D_{\mathrm v,i}` at 2255-2260 under `\leanok` and its existence lemma inherits that definition. For an axis line two distinct seeds with the same coordinate index are different Lean lines yet have the same source line after `\rho_{\mathsf{ALine}}`; equality of these probability laws on the unforgotten samples is ill-typed. The approved branch's `thm:direct-sub-line-distribution` item 3 explicitly used the tilded laws and explained the push-forward; neither main replacement currently does. This is a mathematical correspondence defect exposed by merging the retained tilded notation with main's nodes, not a challenge to the unchanged kernel proofs. The source `lem:qld-sublines` and source restricted consistency remain `\notready`, as they should.

Checks run here: `git diff --check` passed; exact-base blob hashes and the main chapter-15 label set were compared; `lake env lean` on `MixedResampling.lean` and `SubLinePrefix.lean` passed with no diagnostics; focused proof-hole scan over those two files and four integration dependencies found no `sorry`, `admit`, `axiom`, or `native_decide`; worktree remains clean. Input supplied nine exact-head successful CI statuses (summary 299s), and the supplied rooted axiom-audit log concludes no proof-level `\leanok` dependency on `sorryAx`, retaining four statement-only warnings. I did not run CI, full `lake build`, blueprint rendering, a fresh rooted axiom audit, or a new full proof review. The PR's stale title/body understates integration and tests; MAIN owns metadata correction. No code, blueprint or status changes were made by this reviewer.

Code verdict: APPROVED within this bounded integration scope; prose/statement-sync verdict: CHANGES_REQUESTED (two unchecked domain findings). Overall:

VERDICT: CHANGES_REQUESTED
